BiblicalUsage: Unripe — the wheat and the rye not smitten by the hail, because they were not grown up. One verse, in the middle of the plagues, and the detail is God's mercy in the middle of judgment.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the unripe wheat is a small sign of God's restraint: even in the plague, he left something standing.
